name: Fan Out Research Subtopics
description: Fires when the research-coordinator decides fan_out. Spawns a sub-researcher that fetches the coordinator's subtopic list via read_loop_result and investigates one. True parallel fan-out (N agents at once) is out of scope for this milestone — that needs the coordinator's flow-composition tools (ADR-026 milestone 2). See ADR-026 + ADR-028.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.subtopic
on_enter.prompt: A research coordinator has identified subtopics worth separate investigation. Call read_loop_result with loop_id=$entity.id to fetch the coordinator's decision payload (the subtopics list lives there). Pick one subtopic and produce focused findings for it.
